name: pi
title: Pi launcher
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Launch Pi RPC agents and configure their runtime arguments.
description: Adds New Pi agent and Pi runtime settings. New agents run through a bridge in a backend-owned terminal; no prompt is sent automatically. Turn it off to remove these launch/settings controls, not existing Pi processes. Agent controls are provided separately by the agents extension.

needs.why: Pi agents run in a backend terminal

works_with.without: New named-account choices default to ask
A spawned agent keeps human request fallback; initialization failure never replays spawn
Request route initialization is unconfirmed; native spawn is never retried
A new agent opens as its bridge terminal, not an agent panel
A new agent is not opened in a tab
